decisions.reason: The source changes mint-success modal copy and its no-referral condition, not the FAQ content.
The modal describes the existing random ticket award but does not change ticket issuance, eligibility, expiration, or reset rules.
The source concerns an in-product mint-success modal and does not change email delivery or email contents.
The source does not change landing-page hero copy or layout.
The source uses the existing random ticket-and-commission allocation as the basis for modal feedback but does not change the allocation behavior.
The source changes contextual mint-success feedback, not About-page informational copy.
Mentioning a $5 commission and prize ticket in the modal does not change primary-mint revenue allocation.
The source does not change how tickets or commissions are accounted for in dashboards, leaderboards, or NFT views.
The source does not modify Mission-page content.
The source changes modal messaging and does not alter NFT metadata fields or reward-accounting accuracy.

The source does not change fiat-buyer wallet provisioning, wallet assets, dashboard access, or cashout guidance.
